title: Simple modification of phenylphosphonic acid to construct polyester-cotton fabrics with high flame retardancy
journal: Advanced Industrial and Engineering Polymer Research
treatment_method: source PTCO control; no flame-retardant finish
TG_locator: Table 1, Section 3.3; Figure 4 caption identifies N2
pairing_evidence: Sections 2.1 and 2.2.2 define one PTCO control and one preparation each for PTCO/PPOA and PTCO/POU. Tables 1, 2 and 3 repeat these exact three labels for initial fabrics. TG atmosphere is separated by Tables 1 and 2; Table 3 gives one LOI per same fabric state. No post-treatment durability washing series is reported.
peak_assignment_note: Original table numbering retained. In N2 the PTCO control has no Tmax1/Rmax1; Tmax2 and Tmax3 remain second and third source columns. Treated-fabric N2 Tmax1 is the early finish-decomposition event. Air uses its own original stage numbering, including later char oxidation. No generic global Tmax is inferred.
limitations: PPOA add-on is omitted: 25.4 wt% in Section 2.2.2/Table 3 versus 25.2 wt% in Section 3.4. Control Table 3 weight-gain dash stays blank. Preparative NaOH cleaning/rinsing in Section 2.2.2 is not a durability-wash state. Separate TG-FTIR method Section 2.3.9 uses 50 mL/min; its 300/422 C values in Section 3.6 are excluded from these 25 mL/min TG conditions.
